hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '(^|/)(pyproject\.toml|package\.json|docker-compose\.yml|justfile)$' && echo 'COMMANDS_DOC_REMINDER: a dev-tooling file changed; check whether COMMANDS.md needs updating (run /commands).' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'opay-backend/app/core/tenants/.*\.py$|opay-backend/supabase/migrations/.*\.sql$' && echo 'TENANT_DEFAULTS_REMINDER: a tenant schema or DB migration changed. If a new feature/table introduces something a tenant should have default values for, ASK the user whether those defaults belong in the tenant schema (app/core/tenants/schema.py) and the creator (app/core/tenants/cli.py).' || true
